risks_and_omission_opportunities: Do not conflate Rav Huna with his namesake patronymic authority.
Keep the Rav Hanin/Hanan transmitter and Rav as reported authority separate.
Four versus ten units must be interpreted in their local breach/post contexts, not homogenized.
Do not model6a11as unconditional actual-public-domain remedy after6b4.
Do not force ו in לחי וקורה to a new independent conjunctive requirement; retain exact source and established local remedy interpretation.
Door capability differs from actual locking; avoid transferring Jerusalem/Mahuza actual-domain rule wholesale to alleys.
Later all-Rav and noncontradictory-stringency accounts qualify the initial mixed-Rav/Shmuel practice description.
